# third_party

These are vendored third-party files, so they are not covered by the project's own MIT license headers. Both are MIT licensed. See `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` at the repository root, and decision D6.

- doctest 2.4.11 (MIT) - test framework. Used only by `HarnessTests.exe`, never by the release bundle.
- nlohmann/json 3.11.3 (MIT) - https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.11.3/json.hpp, vendored as nlohmann/json.hpp.
